{{Top|ca|leg}}
{{Rankname|legends=1}}
{{Quote|Never again will you be forced to wear a professional party smile when, for all you know, the Cuvacian ambassador has just made a disparaging remark about your parental heritage. With a CLS transliterator you can identify the off-color remark for what it is, and, much to your guest's surprise, return the complement ''[sic]'' in kind with a verbal repartee that will mark you as a social force to be reckoned with.|Advertisement for the Consolidated Learning Systems transliterator in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cuvacian ambassador''' was an individual<ref name="Galladinium" /> who originated from<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the Cuvacian [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]|system=[[Cuvacia system/Legends|Cuvacia system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Cuvacia system/Legends|Cuvacia system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> and fulfilled the duties of an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Galladinium" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an advertisement for [[Consolidated Learning Systems]]' [[transliterator]] in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' mentioned the Cuvacian ambassador. The advertisement promised that the owner of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Language/Legends|language]] and dialect phrase&mdash;including slang&mdash;translator would need not face a situation where they were forced to act courteously at a party while the ambassador spoke in a non&ndash;[[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] language&mdash;and, unbeknown by the other person, delivered an insult about their [[Parent/Legends|parental]] heritage.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Cuvacian ambassador was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
